headline: Part of the Crimea bridge roadway plunges into the sea
notes: Reuters video report, Kerch Strait, 17 Nov 2026. Ukraine struck the bridge; road span fell. 1,441 drones claimed downed by Russia on Tuesday.

headline: American jets hit Iran while tankers burn off Hormuz
notes: US struck an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island on 17 Nov (US official to Reuters). Tara Gas: second strike 17 Nov, 24 crew evacuated. Iran mine claim unverified.

headline: Trump's first Quad summit of his new term, in Manila
notes: Reuters, Manila 17 Nov. First Quad leaders' meeting of Trump's current term. Leaders: Trump, Modi, Takaichi, Albanese. Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen on Thursday 19 Nov.

headline: Congo Ebola: 11,000 cases
notes: UN News, 17 Nov. WHO Director-General Tedros on 17 Nov: more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, 67 health zones, eight provinces. Emergency Committee reviewing the emergency label.

headline: Antalya talks weigh a first draft
notes: Reuters, Antalya 17 Nov. First draft was circulated Monday 16 Nov; on Tuesday 17 Nov delegates were weighing it. Talks close Friday. Draft is a starting point, not agreed.

headline: US measles-free standing lost
notes: PAHO announced 17 Nov that the US lost measles elimination status after 26 years (held since 2000). Uninterrupted spread for more than 12 months. 5,412 cases in 2026 as of 12 Nov.

headline: Nvidia doubles to $115.8bn
notes: Nvidia reported 17 Nov (after close): Q3 revenue $115.8bn, up 103% year over year. Q4 guided near $130bn. First report since Huang resigned 12 Nov.

headline: Rain floods Gaza shelters
notes: AP report 17 Nov. UK, Australia, Canada and Italy joint statement (issued Sunday 16 Nov) urges Israel to open crossings; 150,000 tents held at border. Heavy rain since 6 Nov flooded tens of thousands of tents.

headline: Japan sends jets after breach
notes: AP wire. Two suspected Russian aircraft entered Japanese airspace early Tue 17 Nov near Okinoshima/Fukuoka, ~4:07-4:12 local, for about five minutes; jets scrambled; Tokyo lodged a protest.

headline: EU bans 12 African states' airlines
notes: EU Air Safety List update published 17 Nov 2026: 12 African countries restricted, 87 airlines named (34 from Tanzania, 13 DR Congo, 12 Sudan, 10 Libya). Actor is the EU. Angola has two exceptions (TAAG, Heli Malongo).

headline: Apple fixes iCloud, App Store
notes: AP by Matt Ott, 17 Nov. Apple: many systems back after an internal update caused outages in the morning; working to get the rest online. Full restoration confirmed late Tue evening (~22:46 UTC).

headline: Houthis say drones launched at Riyadh
notes: Reuters 17 Nov. Houthis say they launched five drones towards two pumping stations along the Saudi East-West pipeline in the Riyadh area. No Saudi confirmation. No hit or damage confirmed in the Reuters text.

headline: Beijing hits back at US chip curbs
notes: Reuters 17 Nov. China commerce ministry: firmly opposed the new US rule restricting China's access to advanced AI chips (cloud access), will take countermeasures if the US insists. The US rule itself was announced Mon 16 Nov.

headline: Mongolia president says he'll resign
notes: AP 17 Nov. President Khurelsukh said Tue he will resign; denies wrongdoing and a $25m bribe claim (linked to the Tavantolgoi-Gashuunsukhait railway contract). Resignation takes effect only if parliament accepts it.

headline: Siberia plane crash kills 19
notes: An-12 crashed Tue 17 Nov evening Siberia (~21:30 local / 14:30 UTC) near Yagunovo, Kemerovo; 19 aboard, all killed. Defence Ministry preliminary cause: technical malfunction. Aggregator copy timestamped 18 Nov UTC; the event and wire reporting were 17 Nov.

headline: (as reported) Lebanon: Israeli strikes, shelling and blasts.
notes: No Reuters page found for this story. Location list matches Profile News correspondents field summary for 17 Nov. Do not attribute to Reuters. Kept labelled 'as reported', no casualty numbers.

headline: A second tanker was hit north of Khasab, Oman, UKMTO says.
notes: UKMTO Warning 208-26 Update 001, marker 170745Z (17 Nov 07:45 UTC): second strike, another fire, crew unaccounted for. First strike was 16 Nov ~19:00 UTC, 7nm north of Khasab. UKMTO did not name the vessel.

headline: US stocks slide: S&P 500 -1%, Dow -1.6%, Nasdaq -0.7%.
Nvidia's board rules out bringing Huang back as chief.
notes: Board chair Harvey Jones on the Tue 17 Nov earnings call: the board unanimously accepted Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him as CEO. Huang resigned 12 Nov.

headline: Dubai International: 50.4m travellers, down 28.1%.
notes: Dubai Airports announced Tue 17 Nov: DXB 50.4m passengers Jan-Sep 2026, -28.1% year over year; Q3 18.8m (-22.1%). Figures are for Dubai International (DXB) only, not all Dubai airports.

headline: Saudi-backed forces reinforce Tur al-Baha, 85km from Aden.
notes: The withdrawal from Dhubab Airport / Bab el-Mandeb was announced Sun 15 Nov. The 17 Nov AP report is the follow-up: Saudi-backed forces reinforcing Tur al-Baha, ~85km from Aden, the first line of defence for Aden, after the pullback.

headline: Britain sanctions 8 firms over West Bank building, plus an aid-blocker.
notes: Confirmed 17 Nov: 8 construction/property firms + Tzav 9 (9 entities total), asset freezes + director disqualification. UK FCDO press notice published 2026-11-17T10:04:00Z.

headline: Xi and Carney agree tariff cuts; China eases pork, seafood curbs.
notes: Reuters by Eduardo Baptista, dateline Shenzhen Nov 17. China to cut tariffs on ~C$400m ($280m) of Canadian exports incl. frozen pork and fish/seafood (C$116m pork + C$285m fish/seafood). Canada extends steel/aluminium remissions 2 years. Meeting Tue 17 Nov in Shenzhen.

headline: Mondlane stands trial in Mozambique on five charges.
notes: AP, Maputo. Mondlane went on trial Tue 17 Nov at the Supreme Court on five charges incl. instigating terrorism and inciting civil disobedience. 'Faces up to 24 years' is a maximum penalty (legal expert), not a sentence.

headline: ULA: Vulcan's first stage fell short; 40 Amazon satellites lost.
notes: No AP page found. Primary source is ULA's Tue 17 Nov update (9:30 a.m. EST / 14:30 UTC): 'low booster performance' just after liftoff; stage separation too low/slow to reach orbit; all 40 Amazon Leo satellites lost. Launch was Sun 15 Nov; only the ULA update was 17 Nov.

headline: Cyclone Xavier hits the Northern Cook Islands.
notes: RNZ report 17 Nov. Severe Tropical Cyclone Xavier, Category 5, over the Northern Cook Islands; winds ~215 km/h, gusts up to 295 km/h. Gust figure varies by source/time (Fiji Met Service later put gusts up to 315 km/h).

headline: Voyager 1 nears a light-day from Earth; it crosses early Wednesday.
notes: NASA page published 19 Aug 2026, updated 18 Nov 2026. The page itself is NOT dated 17 Nov. The milestone is correct: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day on Wed 18 Nov 2026 at 10:16:07 UTC. 17 Nov is only the eve (NASA 'Shine Bright' flash event Tue 17 Nov evening). Wording says 'nears' and 'crosses early Wednesday', not that it crosses Tuesday.

headline: UN confirms 2,230 civilian deaths in Sudan, most by drone.
notes: OHCHR page 17 Nov. 1,390 civilians killed Jan-Jun 2026, over 80% by drones; another 840 in the following four months (~520 by drones); total Jan-end Oct over 2,230, of whom over 1,630 by drones. Figures are verified/confirmed only; the true toll is likely higher.

headline: Israel: Kahana wins Knesset speaker vote, 66-52.
notes: Reuters, Jerusalem 17 Nov. Matan Kahana (Eisenkot's Yashar party) elected Knesset speaker Tue 17 Nov, 66-52, replacing Amir Ohana (Likud). Source found is Reuters, not AP.

headline: Moldova closes its skies as 7 drones enter; 5 come down by villages.
notes: Reuters (Alexander Tanas, Chisinau 17 Nov). Defence Ministry recorded 7 drones in Moldovan airspace 15:45-18:10 local on 17 Nov; 5 crashed near villages; one Shahed-type drone tracked toward Chisinau; airspace closed 16:27 local. Source found is Reuters, not AP.

headline: Bangladesh: police use tear gas on garment workers seeking a raise.
notes: The Hindu article exists (17 Nov 12:59 PM IST = 07:29 UTC). No thehindu.com URL was returned by search and the domain is blocked for direct fetch, so no primary URL is reported. Verified via aggregator reproducing The Hindu and corroborated by AFP/TBS: police used tear gas, sound grenades and batons; workers demand Tk 30,000 vs current Tk 12,500.

headline: France: 146,000 join wage protests; unions want higher pay.
notes: Event is 17 Nov but the Le Monde article itself is dated 18 Nov (URL /2026/11/18/; crawled 18 Nov 02:40 UTC). Numbers verified: 146,000 across France incl. 28,000 in Paris, per the Interior Ministry; CGT counter-claim 500,000+ incl. 175,000 in Paris.

headline: India: bus plunges 100m into a Uttarakhand gorge; 9 dead, 25 hurt.
notes: PTI dispatch (Amar Ujala, updated Tue 17 Nov 09:48 AM IST = 04:18 UTC). Morning figures were 8 killed, 26 injured; a later PTI update the same day revised the toll to 9 killed, 25 injured, and confirmed 34 aboard. The entry uses the final 9/25 figures. Bus fell ~100m below Gular bridge near Gular Bazaar, Tehri Garhwal, ~04:30, Haridwar to Chamoli.

headline: Dhaka leads the world's most polluted cities; AQI 292.
notes: UNB byline, hosted on tbsnews.net. Published 17 Nov 2026, 11:50 am local (+06:00) = 05:50 UTC; AQI 292 recorded at 11:30 am local (05:30 UTC) on 17 Nov, ranked 1st, 'very unhealthy' (201-300 band); Lahore 2nd at 246.
